about_the_game:
Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker: Doomsday Vanguard Tank DLC

Unleash the full fury of a steel storm! The new DLC, "Doomsday Vanguard," for Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker is here, introducing a futuristic armored tank with a bombardment role. This isn't about elegantly eliminating zombies; it's about erasing enemies from the map—with deafening cannon fire, ground-tearing shockwaves, and that ironclad rule etched onto its barrel: "To live is to retaliate."

Tank Traits:

Every 10th attack fires a Doomsday Shell. The power of the Doomsday Shell is the sum of all equipped weapon powers, resulting in massive damage. If hit consecutively by the Doomsday Shell, the damage inflicted multiplies with each hit.

Now, command this behemoth of steel and ignite the plains with warfare. Whether facing hordes of mechanical hounds or deeply buried war bunkers, everything will turn to dust under its roar.

Feature Highlights:

  • A stunning tank design: The "Doomsday Vanguard" centers on post-apocalyptic wasteland technology, blending streamlined armor with heavy riveted structures. Its striking yellow and black paint scheme resembles a deadly swarm of bees on the wasteland, bold and intimidating. With its towering stealth main gun, shoulder-mounted missile arrays, and back-mounted energy heat sinks, every detail highlights its identity as a "mobile fortress." Whether standing ready or charging at full speed, it serves as an unmissable steel totem on the battlefield.

  • Powerful traits: Just like its trait name, "Doomsday Judgment," the very existence of the Doomsday Vanguard completely upends the rules of engagement. It doesn't aim for prolonged combat or evasion but overwhelms with firepower and intimidation, declaring that "bombardment is dominance."
